name: OMol25
brief: Small molecules, biomolecules, electrolytes, and metal complexes computed at a high level of theory (ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD, in ORCA 6), deliberately including the charged and open-shell species most datasets skip. Built to be the first molecular corpus to pair this chemical breadth with high-accuracy DFT at this scale.
paperTitle: The Open Molecules 2025 (OMol25) Dataset, Evaluations, and Models
primaryPaper: Levine et al., Open Molecules 2025: A Foundation Dataset for Molecular Chemistry, arXiv:2505.xxxxx (2025).
